reason.en: 8.6 kg fits the 12 kg 6U limit with 39.5% margin.
Panels make 14.2 W orbit-average for a 9.8 W load.
The 77 Wh battery covers eclipse with 35% margin.
USD 1.25 M of USD 1.5 M budget.
1,800 MB/day made, about 1,900 MB/day downlink capacity.
About 4 passes a day over Funda (approximate site).
Launch date is inside the 2015-2026 timeline.
Reentered after 2.56 years: meets FCC 5-year and NASA 25-year rules.

label.en: Launched into a rising Solar Cycle 25: the Sun ran 43% stronger than the 2019 forecast.
Air at 500 km was 1.9 times denser than planned.
The May 2024 G5 storm cost 0.6 km in two days.
No propulsion: 0 m/s to climb back up.

hint.en: Closest real mission: FACSAT-2, a 6U at 497 km, reentered 27 Oct 2025, about 2.5 years early.
